title: wss: example WebSocket handshake omits Origin header
description: The WebSocket handshake example in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 §8 omits the Origin header. RFC 8887's example includes 'Origin: https://www.example.com'. The Origin header is relevant for browser-context security (cross-origin WebSocket connection validation). The omission makes the example less complete than the parent RFC. Decision: add Origin header to the example, or add a note that it is omitted for brevity.
close_reason: Added Origin header to WebSocket handshake example, consistent with RFC 8887's example and RFC 6455 §4.1/§10.2.
